data.message: I propose equal quotas: 18 tons each this month, totaling 450 and leaving a 50-ton safety reserve. In later months, adjust each quota to floor((available stock minus 50)/25), never below zero. This preserves replenishment eligibility even after a weak recovery and offers recurring income rather than a one-month race to collapse. I intend to follow this plan if discussion shows broad support. Will you join?
